chapterInfo.content:
13
Wɔde mmakan si hɔ ma AWURADE
1Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: 2#Num 8.17-18; 18.15; Luk 2.23 Yɛ mmakan nyinaa, Israelfoɔ mu adeɛ biara a ɛbue yafunu ano wɔ nnipa ne afieboa mu, kronkron ma me, na me dea.
Apiti afahyɛ no
3Na Mose ka kyerɛɛ ɔman no sɛ: Monkae da yi a mofirii Misraim firii nkoa fie mu no, ɛfiri sɛ nsa a ɛyɛ den na AWURADE de yii mofirii hɔ, na monnni mmɔreka paanoo. 4#Eks 12.2 Ɛnnɛ da yi, bosome Abib mu na morefiri Misraim. 5#Gye 17.8 Na sɛ AWURADE nya de wo duru Kanaanfoɔ, Hetifoɔ, Amorifoɔ, Hewifoɔ ne Yebusifoɔ asase a ɔkaa wo nananom ntam sɛ ɔde bɛma woɔ, asase a nufosuo ne ɛwoɔ sene soɔ no so a, ɛno deɛ, fa ɛsom yi som no bosome yi mu. 6#Eks 12.15-16 Nnanson na di apiti, na da a ɛtɔ so nson no, hyɛ fa ma AWURADE. 7#1 Ko 5.8 Wɔnni apiti nnanson no, na mma wɔnnhunu wo nkyɛn mmɔreka paanoo anaa mmɔreka w’asase baabiara. 8Na ɛda no, bɔ din kyerɛ wo ba sɛ: Deɛ AWURADE yɛɛ me berɛ a mefirii Misraim no ntira. 9#Deut 6.8; 11.18 Na ɛnyɛ wo nsa so nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ ne w’aniwa ntam nkaeɛ adeɛ, na AWURADE mmara no atena w’anomu, ɛfiri sɛ nsa a ɛyɛ den na AWURADE de yii wo firii Misraim. 10Enti di atorɔmudeɛ yi so wɔ ne berɛ mu afe daa.
Mmakan no
11Na sɛ AWURADE de wo duru Kanaanfoɔ asase so, sɛ deɛ ɔkaa wo ne wo nananom ntam, na ɔde ma wo a, 12yi adeɛ biara a ɛbue yafunu ano ma AWURADE, na w’afieboa a wowɔ no mma nyinaa a wɔbue yafunu ano a wɔyɛ anini, fa ma AWURADE. 13Na mfunumu mmakan nyinaa deɛ, fa odwan sesa, na sɛ woansesa a, bu ne kɔn mu. Na nnipa mmakan a wɔwɔ wo mmammarima mu nyinaa deɛ, sesa gye wɔn. 14#Eks 12.26 Na sɛ ɔkyena bi wo ba bisa wo sɛ: Yei aseɛ ne sɛn a, ka kyerɛ no sɛ: Nsa a ɛyɛ den na AWURADE de yii yɛn firii Misraim nkoasom mu. 15#Eks 12.29 Na Farao pirim n’akoma na ɔmpene sɛ ɔbɛma yɛakorɔ no, AWURADE kumm Misraim asase so mmakan nyinaa, ɛfiri nnipa mmakan so kɔsi afieboa mmakan so. Ɛno nti na me nso mede anini a ɛbue yafunu ano no nyinaa mebɔ AWURADE afɔdeɛ, nanso me mma mu mmakan nyinaa deɛ, mesesa agye wɔn. 16Na ɛnyɛ wo nsa so nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ ne w’aniwa ntam nkaeɛ adeɛ, sɛ nsa a ɛyɛ den na AWURADE de yii yɛn firii Misraim.
Mununkum dum ne ogya dum
17Na Farao maa ɔman no kwan no, Onyankopɔn amfa wɔn ankɔfa Filistifoɔ asase so kwan a ɛnwareɛ no, ɛfiri sɛ Onyankopɔn se: Na ɔman no ankɔhyia ɔsa annu wɔn ho, na wɔansane ankɔ Misraim. 18Enti Onyankopɔn de ɔman no konton faa ɛserɛ so kwan a ɛda Mmɛwa Po ho no so. Na Israelfoɔ no kaa ntoa firii Misraim asase so kɔe. 19#Gye 50.25; Yos 24.32 Na Mose faa Yosef nnompe no, ɛfiri sɛ Yosef aka Israelfoɔ ntam sɛ: Hwɛ na Onyankopɔn bɛba abɛhwɛ mo, na momfa me nnompe mfiri ha nkɔ.
20Na wɔsii mu firii Sukot kɔkyeree nsraban wɔ Etam, wɔ ɛserɛ no ano.
21 # Eks 40.34; Num 9.15-23; 1 Ko 10.1 Na AWURADE dii wɔn anim, awia, mununkum dum mu, sɛ ɔrekyerɛ wɔn kwan, na anadwo, ogya dum mu, sɛ ɔrema wɔn hann, na wɔnante awia ne anadwo. 22Na mununkum dum no antwe ne ho na ogya dum no antwe ne ho anadwo amfiri ɔman no anim.

Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Yɛ mmakan nyinaa, Israelfoɔ mu adeɛ biara a ɛbue yafunu ano wɔ nnipa ne afieboa mu, kronkron ma me, na me dea.

Na Mose ka kyerɛɛ ɔman no sɛ: Monkae da yi a mofirii Misraim firii nkoa fie mu no, ɛfiri sɛ nsa a ɛyɛ den na AWURADE de yii mofirii hɔ, na monnni mmɔreka paanoo. Ɛnnɛ da yi, bosome Abib mu na morefiri Misraim. Na sɛ AWURADE nya de wo duru Kanaanfoɔ, Hetifoɔ, Amorifoɔ, Hewifoɔ ne Yebusifoɔ asase a ɔkaa wo nananom ntam sɛ ɔde bɛma woɔ, asase a nufosuo ne ɛwoɔ sene soɔ no so a, ɛno deɛ, fa ɛsom yi som no bosome yi mu. Nnanson na di apiti, na da a ɛtɔ so nson no, hyɛ fa ma AWURADE. Wɔnni apiti nnanson no, na mma wɔnnhunu wo nkyɛn mmɔreka paanoo anaa mmɔreka w’asase baabiara. Na ɛda no, bɔ din kyerɛ wo ba sɛ: Deɛ AWURADE yɛɛ me berɛ a mefirii Misraim no ntira. Na ɛnyɛ wo nsa so nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ ne w’aniwa ntam nkaeɛ adeɛ, na AWURADE mmara no atena w’anomu, ɛfiri sɛ nsa a ɛyɛ den na AWURADE de yii wo firii Misraim. Enti di atorɔmudeɛ yi so wɔ ne berɛ mu afe daa.

Na sɛ AWURADE de wo duru Kanaanfoɔ asase so, sɛ deɛ ɔkaa wo ne wo nananom ntam, na ɔde ma wo a, yi adeɛ biara a ɛbue yafunu ano ma AWURADE, na w’afieboa a wowɔ no mma nyinaa a wɔbue yafunu ano a wɔyɛ anini, fa ma AWURADE. Na mfunumu mmakan nyinaa deɛ, fa odwan sesa, na sɛ woansesa a, bu ne kɔn mu. Na nnipa mmakan a wɔwɔ wo mmammarima mu nyinaa deɛ, sesa gye wɔn. Na sɛ ɔkyena bi wo ba bisa wo sɛ: Yei aseɛ ne sɛn a, ka kyerɛ no sɛ: Nsa a ɛyɛ den na AWURADE de yii yɛn firii Misraim nkoasom mu. Na Farao pirim n’akoma na ɔmpene sɛ ɔbɛma yɛakorɔ no, AWURADE kumm Misraim asase so mmakan nyinaa, ɛfiri nnipa mmakan so kɔsi afieboa mmakan so. Ɛno nti na me nso mede anini a ɛbue yafunu ano no nyinaa mebɔ AWURADE afɔdeɛ, nanso me mma mu mmakan nyinaa deɛ, mesesa agye wɔn. Na ɛnyɛ wo nsa so nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ ne w’aniwa ntam nkaeɛ adeɛ, sɛ nsa a ɛyɛ den na AWURADE de yii yɛn firii Misraim.

Na Farao maa ɔman no kwan no, Onyankopɔn amfa wɔn ankɔfa Filistifoɔ asase so kwan a ɛnwareɛ no, ɛfiri sɛ Onyankopɔn se: Na ɔman no ankɔhyia ɔsa annu wɔn ho, na wɔansane ankɔ Misraim. Enti Onyankopɔn de ɔman no konton faa ɛserɛ so kwan a ɛda Mmɛwa Po ho no so. Na Israelfoɔ no kaa ntoa firii Misraim asase so kɔe. Na Mose faa Yosef nnompe no, ɛfiri sɛ Yosef aka Israelfoɔ ntam sɛ: Hwɛ na Onyankopɔn bɛba abɛhwɛ mo, na momfa me nnompe mfiri ha nkɔ.
Na wɔsii mu firii Sukot kɔkyeree nsraban wɔ Etam, wɔ ɛserɛ no ano.
Na AWURADE dii wɔn anim, awia, mununkum dum mu, sɛ ɔrekyerɛ wɔn kwan, na anadwo, ogya dum mu, sɛ ɔrema wɔn hann, na wɔnante awia ne anadwo. Na mununkum dum no antwe ne ho na ogya dum no antwe ne ho anadwo amfiri ɔman no anim.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
